Looking at the validator errors, I can see two main issues:

1. **"block" is not allowed in genre block** — The keyword `block` should not be used to declare nodes in a block diagram. Nodes should be declared with just the id and label.

2. **edge needs an operator** — Edges require directional operators like `->`, `<-`, `--`, or `<->`. Since this is a directed flow of work, `->` is appropriate.

Here's the corrected document:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Certificate renewal automation"

scheduler "Scheduler"
renewaljob "Renewal Job"
caclient "CA Client"
ca "Certificate Authority"
deployagent "Deploy Agent"
service "Service"

scheduler -> renewaljob
renewaljob -> caclient
caclient -> ca
renewaljob -> deployagent
deployagent -> service
```

The changes:
- Removed `block` keyword from node declarations (lines 5–10)
- Added `->` directional operator to all edges (lines 12–16)
- Kept all required ids, labels, and connections as specified
